calculators.name: Assembly Molding - Insert loading
calculators.description: Loading a shot's inserts into the mold, by hand or by robot: each insert's load time by its weight and the load method (componentLoadTime: Manual or Robotic, the first row whose weight takes it), summed over the inserts of every cavity; a manual load is slowed by handlingMultiplier and insertionMultiplier for handling and seating the insert.

source.engine: load_time_s (componentLoadTime of each insert by its weight and the load method, summed per shot)
manual (1 for a manual load, 0 for a robot)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Load Time} * ({Manual Load} * {Handling Multiplier} * {Insertion Multiplier} + 1 - {Manual Load}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Assembly Molding - Shot cycle
calculators.description: One shot of an insert molding press: on a press with a rotary or shuttle table the next lower mold half is loaded while the other is molded (defaultNumMoldToolsPerTable halves), so the shot takes the longer of the two; on a press with no table the inserts are loaded with the mold open, so the two add.

source.engine: molding_cycle_s (the injection cycle of the shot)
insert_load_s (the insert loading of the shot)
table_press (1 for a rotary or shuttle table, 0 for none)

fields.name: Shot Cycle
fields.formula: {Table Press} * max({Molding Cycle}, {Load Time}) + (1 - {Table Press}) * ({Molding Cycle} + {Load Time})
